seo.title: Partners | M20 Technology
seo.description: M20 Technology partners with Atlassian, Tempo, Refined, Appfire, Adaptavist, and other leading vendors to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

hero.title: Partners
hero.intro: Working together to provide exceptional customer experiences.

partners.name: Atlassian
partners.text: Millions of people rely on Atlassian products every day to improve software development, project management, collaboration, and code quality.

partners.name: Squarespace
partners.text: Squarespace helps people with creative ideas succeed: anyone can build and edit a website from pre-built templates and drag-and-drop elements, without writing code.

partners.name: ServiceRocket
partners.text: ServiceRocket supports thousands of businesses around the world with Atlassian services, training, and software solutions, backed by a dedicated global team.

partners.name: Adaptavist
partners.text: Adaptavist specializes in platform integration and custom app development, turning business concepts into workable tools.

partners.name: Pledge 1%
partners.text: Pledge 1% gives companies turnkey tools and best practices that make it easy to build philanthropy into their business model.

partners.name: Tempo
partners.text: Tempo offers integrated time management, resource planning, and budget management for software engineering and product management teams.

partners.name: Refined
partners.text: Refined powers branded intranets, documentation sites, and knowledge bases, as well as custom-themed help and support sites.

partners.name: Appfire
partners.text: Appfire builds enterprise collaboration solutions for your team, your ecosystem, and your best work.

partners.name: Elements
partners.text: Elements develops and markets apps that enhance Jira and Confluence so teams can work more efficiently.

partners.name: Open Source Consulting
partners.text: Open Source Consulting is a cloud migration company that provides the technology solutions and services for successful cloud adoption and a collaborative culture.

partners.name: Exalate
partners.text: Exalate sets up integrations between Jira, GitHub, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, HP QC/ALM, and more.

partners.name: JXL
partners.text: JXL makes Jira easier and faster at any scale, saving countless clicks and hours.

partners.name: Revyz
partners.text: Revyz gives you confidence in the cloud with enterprise-grade protection from all forms of data loss and cyber threats.

partners.name: QMetry
partners.text: QMetry is a scalable, compliance-driven quality orchestration platform that helps teams deliver quality at speed with improved ROI.

partners.name: SmartBear
partners.text: SmartBear provides AI-enhanced software quality tools that streamline end-to-end software delivery.
